arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && md5sum scratch/report.md && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
s=open('scratch/report.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
m=re.search(r'^## 风险[ \t]*$',s,re.M)
start=m.end()
n=re.search(r'^## ',s[start:],re.M)
body=s[start:start+n.start()] if n else s[start:]
open('scratch/risk.txt','w',encoding='utf-8').write(body.strip())
EOF
md5sum scratch/report.md; cat -A scratch/risk.txt; echo; cat scratch/risk.txt
